boundaries: Six registered CC0 design assets, not actual commercial SKUs, certified materials, inventory, prices, orders or physical fit data. Historical table-glass ID does not certify glass; display normalization does not represent retail dimensions.
C05 swaps two existing slots and preserves a complete six-ID permutation. Pinned endpoints reject movement. Drag selection follows the dragged item; wishlist is independent.

C33 uses visible editorial tags and fixed weights, stable ties and pinned indices. Preview is non-mutating; application is one transaction. No inferred personal profile, recommendation model or material certification.

C35 parses a finite explicit Chinese command into one of six local registered scenes. It requires a validated checkpoint and matching token/path for the safe return link; unknown, negative, composite or URL input cannot create arbitrary destinations.
Scene transitions preserve collection context and use each target's own existing workspace. Selected assets are not automatically inserted, and unseen scenes are not generated.

Complete local JSON supports six registered IDs and40 history entries; raw imports are limited to64KiB. Observation view is transient and does not edit the collection. No cloud sync or external model backend.
